ValidationRule.description: BOH Lead should be assigned to User if Status is Closed and Sub Status is 'Opportunity Identified' or 'Refer to Classic'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c == false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ANZX_Leads' , Is_BOH_Lead__c = true , ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), OR( ISPICKVAL(SubStatus__c, "Opportunity identified"), ISPICKVAL(SubStatus__c, "Referred to Classic") ), BEGINS( OwnerId ,'00G') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Leads with the status "Closed" and sub-status "Opportunity identified" or "Referred to Classic" must be assigned to a user before closing. Please assign the lead to a user.
